test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The soldiers showed __fortitude__ and resilience while facing the opponents.
solution:
The correct answer is:'Bravery'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word '**fortitude'__ **means '**strength of mind that enables a person to encounter danger or bear pain or adversity with courage'**.
 
• The meaning '**bravery'** means '**the quality or state of having or showing mental or moral strength to face danger, fear, or difficulty'**.
 
• The meaning of the above two words is almost the same to each other.

Therefore, the appropriate synonym of '**fortitude'** is '***Bravery'.*** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Let's see the meaning of other words:

 
• **'Ingenuity'** means '**skill or cleverness in devising or combining'.**
 
• **'Atrocity'** means** 'an extremely wicked or cruel act, typically one involving physical violence or injury'.**
 
• **'Conscientiousness'** means '**the quality of wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly'.**
